decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core vessel-management business backed by a dedicated unit, it likely meets aspiration levels well enough in an expanding firm with slack, so there is little pressure to withdraw it.

Because travel management strongly complements the firm's crew and corporate support services, management would likely retain it unless results clearly disappointed, and a large expanding firm can absorb some uncertainty.

The online portal fits the push to broaden service scope and improve client proximity, but as a newer digital service in a low-R&D industry it faces somewhat higher uncertainty, raising but not dominating the chance of withdrawal.

The mobile performance app is strategically relevant to safer and cleaner shipping, yet as the most development-intensive and potentially harder-to-scale offering it is the most vulnerable if results fall short of aspirations, though current slack still favors keeping it.
